Reflection:
The bookmarks bar is currently hidden in Chromium, so before creating a new folder on it we need to reveal it. The quickest way is to toggle it with the keyboard shortcut Ctrl+Shift+B.

```python
import pyautogui
import time

# Show the bookmarks bar
pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 'shift', 'b')
time.sleep(0.5)
```

import time

```python
pyautogui.rightClick(300, 150)
time.sleep(0.5)
```

Reflection:  
The “New folder” dialog is open. I need to rename the folder from “New folder” to “Favorites” by selecting the name field, typing the new name, and then clicking “Save.”

```python
import pyautogui
import time

# Focus and rename the folder
pyautogui.click(736 + 575//2, 207 + 38//2)  # Click the name entry
time.sleep(0.2)
pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 'a')               # Select all text
time.sleep(0.1)
pyautogui.typewrite('Favorites', interval=0.05)
time.sleep(0.2)

# Click the Save button
pyautogui.click(1229 + 82//2, 656 + 39//2)
time.sleep(0.5)
```
